shortlist.label: Angiolymphoid Hyperplasia with Eosinophilia
shortlist.why_kept: persistent periorbital swelling and dermal ectatic blood vessels

shortlist.label: Kimura Disease
shortlist.why_kept: persistent periorbital swelling and lymphatic involvement

shortlist.label: Lymphangioma
shortlist.why_kept: periorbital soft-tissue swelling and lymphatic malformation

shortlist.label: Eosinophilic Angiocentric Fibrosis
shortlist.why_kept: persistent periorbital swelling and eosinophilic infiltrate

shortlist.label: Acquired Lymphangiectasia
shortlist.why_kept: periorbital soft-tissue swelling and lymphatic ectasia

raw.rationale: The presence of numerous dermal ectatic blood vessels and lymphatics with a sparse lymphocytic infiltrate on skin biopsy is consistent with Angiolymphoid Hyperplasia with Eosinophilia, which is characterized by vascular and lymphatic proliferation.

rejected.label: Kimura Disease
rejected.why: Typically presents with lymphadenopathy and eosinophilia, which are not mentioned in the vignette

rejected.label: Lymphangioma
rejected.why: Usually presents at birth or in early childhood, and the biopsy findings do not specifically suggest a lymphatic malformation

rejected.label: Eosinophilic Angiocentric Fibrosis
rejected.why: Typically presents with nasal or respiratory symptoms, which are not mentioned in the vignette

rejected.label: Acquired Lymphangiectasia
rejected.why: Would likely present with more pronounced lymphatic dilation and possibly lymphedema, which is not described in the vignette
